title: iPhone 16 Pro Max case
blurb: A parametric phone case, written in OpenSCAD with BOSL2 after the housing, to see whether the same approach transfers. Only the body - 163.0 x 77.6 x 8.25 mm - could be verified from Apple's specs; the corner radius, camera island and every button position are estimates, each marked MEASURE in the file. For TPU, not PLA: a case has to stretch to go on and come off.
